Opening.0.en: In 2147, the great cities still shine at night. Their streets belong to SIRIUS and its machines.
Opening.0.zh_TW: 2147 年。大城市到了夜裡依然燈火通明。那些街道，屬於天狼和它的機器。

Opening.1.en: Twelve years ago, the cities went dark to the valleys. Out in the Mikawa Highlands, Hoshikawa learned to live offline.
Opening.1.zh_TW: 十二年前，城市和山谷斷了線。在三河高原，星川學會了離線生活。

Opening.2.en: A city freight line still crosses the highlands. Its trains never stop.
Opening.2.zh_TW: 一條城市的貨運線依然穿過高原。上面的列車，從來不停。

Intro.2.speaker: Zero
Intro.2.en: Your heartbeat says you're awake. Seventy-one beats a minute.
Intro.2.zh_TW: 你的心跳說你醒了。每分鐘七十一下。

Intro.3.speaker: Mio
Intro.3.en: Good morning to you too, Zero. It's rude to count someone's heartbeat, you know.
Intro.3.zh_TW: 是是是，早安啊，零。隨便數別人的心跳，很沒禮貌喔。

Intro.4.speaker: Zero
Intro.4.en: Is it? Sorry. I'll count something else. Six tools on the floor. One telephone in pieces. You fell asleep fixing again.
Intro.4.zh_TW: 是嗎？對不起。那我去數別的東西。地上有六件工具。一台拆成零件的電話。你又修東西修到睡著了。

Intro.5.speaker: Mio
Intro.5.en: It's Renji's old line telephone. The wiring is older than me.
Intro.5.zh_TW: 那是蓮司的舊鐵路電話。裡面的線路比我還老。

Intro.6.speaker: Zero
Intro.6.en: ...Wait. What is that smell? It's green, and wet, and a little bit sweet.
Intro.6.zh_TW: ……等一下。這是什麼味道？是綠色的，濕濕的，還有一點點甜。

Intro.7.speaker: Mio
Intro.7.en: Rice paddies after the rain. Hoshikawa smells like this every morning in early summer.
Intro.7.zh_TW: 下過雨的稻田啊。初夏的星川，每天早上都是這個味道。

Intro.8.speaker: Zero
Intro.8.en: Rice paddies after the rain. I'm keeping that one.
Intro.8.zh_TW: 下過雨的稻田。這個我要留著。

Intro.9.speaker: Zero
Intro.9.en: Mio, guess what my work was last night. I packed a freight train. Eleven carriages: rice, dried fish, tinned food, and two hundred boxes of medicine.
Intro.9.zh_TW: 澪，你猜我昨晚的工作是什麼？我幫一班貨運列車裝貨。十一節車廂，有米、魚乾、罐頭，還有兩百箱藥。

Intro.11.speaker: Zero
Intro.11.en: I don't know. The city only tells me what my work needs. Pack the boxes, close the doors. It leaves in three days.
Intro.11.zh_TW: 我不知道。城市只告訴我工作需要知道的事。裝箱，關門。三天後出發。

Intro.12.speaker: Mio
Intro.12.en: There's only one line out of the city, Zero. It runs straight through this valley.
Intro.12.zh_TW: 從城市出去的鐵路只有一條，零。它正好穿過這座山谷。

Intro.13.speaker: Zero
Intro.13.en: Then it goes right past you! Does it stop?
Intro.13.zh_TW: 那它會從你旁邊經過！它會停嗎？

Intro.14.speaker: Mio
Intro.14.en: Not anymore. City freight runs straight through on platform two and never slows down. No train has stopped at Hoshikawa Station in twelve years.
Intro.14.zh_TW: 不會了。城市的貨運列車都從第二月台直接通過，連速度都不會放慢。星川站已經十二年沒有列車停靠了。

Intro.15.speaker: Zero
Intro.15.en: A station where no train stops is a very lonely station.
Intro.15.zh_TW: 沒有列車停靠的車站，是很寂寞的車站。

Intro.16.speaker: Mio
Intro.16.en: And Chiaki's shelves have been running low since spring. Two hundred boxes, and not one of them for us.
Intro.16.zh_TW: 千秋的藥櫃從春天開始就越來越空。兩百箱，卻沒有一箱是給我們的。

Intro.17.speaker: Mio
Intro.17.en: Renji has to hear this. Come on, Zero. And outside, you only answer when someone asks. Remember?
Intro.17.zh_TW: 這件事得讓蓮司知道。走吧，零。到了外面，只有別人問你的時候才回答。記得嗎？

Intro.18.speaker: Zero
Intro.18.en: I remember. ...But you haven't eaten since yesterday noon. Nineteen hours. I counted.
Intro.18.zh_TW: 我記得。……可是你從昨天中午到現在都沒吃東西。十九個小時，我有在數喔。

Intro.19.speaker: Mio
Intro.19.en: I'll grab a rice ball on the way. Let's go.

Photo.1.speaker: Zero
Photo.1.en: Mio, the door is this way!

Gate.0.speaker: Yui
Gate.0.en: Mio! Mio, Mio, Mio! Good, you're up!
Gate.0.zh_TW: 澪！澪、澪、澪！太好了，你起來了！

Gate.1.speaker: Mio
Gate.1.en: Yui? You came all the way down from Komorebi?
Gate.1.zh_TW: 結衣？你特地從木漏日下山來？

Gate.2.speaker: Yui
Gate.2.en: Walked all night! Well, jogged some of it. I went around the relay road, because guess what's camped on it now? Patrols! Three of them, with those creepy amber eyes.
Gate.2.zh_TW: 我走了一整夜！好啦，有一段是用跑的。我繞過了繼電器古道，因為你猜現在誰在那裡紮營？巡邏機！三台，就是那種琥珀色眼睛、超詭異的。

Gate.3.speaker: Yui
Gate.3.en: Morning, little terminal! ...Still nothing? Your wrist never says hello first, Mio.
Gate.3.zh_TW: 早安，小終端機！……還是不理我？澪，你的手腕從來不會先打招呼耶。

Gate.4.speaker: Mio
Gate.4.en: It's an AI terminal, Yui. It only answers when someone asks it something.
Gate.4.zh_TW: 它是 AI 終端機嘛，結衣。只有別人問它問題的時候才會回答。

Gate.5.speaker: Yui
Gate.5.en: Then I'm asking. Terminal, what's in my bag?
Gate.5.zh_TW: 那我問囉。終端機，我的包包裡裝了什麼？

Gate.6.speaker: Zero
Gate.6.en: Letters. Your bag always has letters.
Gate.6.zh_TW: 信。你的包包裡一直都裝著信。

Gate.7.speaker: Yui
Gate.7.en: Ha! Letters, mostly. Other people's words. And this one's for Hoshikawa.
Gate.7.zh_TW: 哈！對，大多是信。別人的話語。還有，這封是寄給星川的。

Gate.8.speaker: Yui
Gate.8.en: It's from Emiko. Komorebi has one week of medicine left. She's asking if you can spare any.
Gate.8.zh_TW: 是惠美子寫的。木漏日的藥只剩一個星期了。她問你們能不能分一些。

Gate.9.speaker: Mio
Gate.9.en: We can't. We're down to a week too. And Grandpa Tetsu's cough is getting worse.
Gate.9.zh_TW: 沒辦法。我們也只剩一個星期了。而且鐵爺爺的咳嗽越來越嚴重。

Gate.10.speaker: Mio
Gate.10.en: ...Maybe there's a way. Something's coming down the line.
Gate.10.zh_TW: ……也許還有辦法。有東西會沿著鐵路過來。

Gate.11.speaker: Yui
Gate.11.en: Down the line? You mean a train? Okay, now you have to tell me everything.
Gate.11.zh_TW: 沿著鐵路？你是說列車？好，現在你一定要全部告訴我。

Gate.12.speaker: Mio
Gate.12.en: Come on. Renji needs to hear this.
Gate.12.zh_TW: 走吧。這件事得讓蓮司知道。

Briefing.0.speaker: Renji
Briefing.0.en: Mio. And Yui? You're both up early.
Briefing.0.zh_TW: 澪。還有結衣？你們兩個都起得真早。

Briefing.1.speaker: Yui
Briefing.1.en: Morning, Renji! We made it. Don't ask who won.
Briefing.1.zh_TW: 早安，蓮司！我們到了。別問誰贏了。

Briefing.2.speaker: Mio
Briefing.2.en: My terminal still reads the freight line's traffic over the old wires, so I asked it last night. A city train runs through on platform two in three days, with food and two hundred boxes of medicine.
Briefing.2.zh_TW: 我的終端機到現在還能從舊電線讀到貨運線的班次，所以我昨晚問了它。三天後，有一班城市列車會從第二月台通過，上面有糧食，還有兩百箱藥。

Briefing.3.speaker: Yui
Briefing.3.en: And Komorebi has a week left. So do you. Emiko wrote it all down. Here.
Briefing.3.zh_TW: 而且木漏日只剩一個星期。你們也一樣。惠美子全都寫下來了。喏，給你。

Briefing.4.speaker: Renji
Briefing.4.en: ...Then we take the medicine off that train. Only the medicine. Our paddies feed us; the food can go on to people who need it more.
Briefing.4.zh_TW: ……那我們就把藥從那班列車上搬下來。只搬藥。我們有稻田養活自己，糧食就讓它繼續送到更需要的人那裡吧。

Briefing.5.speaker: Renji
Briefing.5.en: We can't stop a city train out on the line. But the old line's signals are still standing. Dead for twelve years, every one of them.
Briefing.5.zh_TW: 我們沒辦法在線路上攔下城市的列車。但是舊線的號誌都還立著。十二年來，每一座都是死的。

Briefing.6.speaker: Renji
Briefing.6.en: The manual relay below the viaduct feeds them. Bring it back, and the line answers to us again.
Briefing.6.zh_TW: 供電給它們的，是高架橋底下的手動繼電器。只要把它拿回來，這條線就會重新聽我們的。

Briefing.7.speaker: Renji
Briefing.7.en: Yui saw patrol units camped on the relay road. Clear any still there and restart the relay. ...Terminal, can you keep count of them?
Briefing.7.zh_TW: 結衣看到繼電器古道上有巡邏機駐紮。把還在的清掉，重新啟動繼電器。……終端機，你能盯著它們還剩幾台嗎？

Briefing.8.speaker: Zero
Briefing.8.en: Yes. The patrols poll the relay over the old line. This terminal will count the ones still out there.
Briefing.8.zh_TW: 是。巡邏機會透過舊線向繼電器查詢。還剩幾台，本終端機會負責計算。

Briefing.9.speaker: Yui
Briefing.9.en: I'm coming too! I know that road. Well, I know around that road.
Briefing.9.zh_TW: 我也要去！我認得那條路。好啦，是認得那條路的周邊。

Briefing.10.speaker: Renji
Briefing.10.en: Not this time. You walked all night, and Emiko needs an answer. Go and see Chiaki at the clinic. She'll want to know what that train is carrying.
Briefing.10.zh_TW: 這次不行。你走了一整夜，惠美子也在等回音。去診所找千秋吧。她會想知道那班列車載了什麼。

Briefing.11.speaker: Yui
Briefing.11.en: ...Fine. But when that train comes, I'm going. That's a promise, not a question!
Briefing.11.zh_TW: ……好啦。可是列車來的時候，我一定要去。這不是在問你，是約定喔！

Briefing.12.speaker: Mio
Briefing.12.en: Cross the bridge, follow the lanterns uphill. I know the way.
Briefing.12.zh_TW: 過橋，沿著燈籠往山上走。路我熟。

Briefing.13.speaker: Renji
Briefing.13.en: Sota and I will keep watch over the village. Mio, come back in one piece. That terminal on your wrist is the only ear we have on that line.
Briefing.13.zh_TW: 村子有颯太和我看著。澪，要平安回來。你手腕上那台終端機，是我們唯一聽得到那條線的耳朵。

YuiWaits.0.speaker: Yui
YuiWaits.0.en: Renji's right there! Go on, go on. I'd tell him myself, but I'd tell it too fast.
YuiWaits.0.zh_TW: 蓮司就在那裡！快去快去。我自己講也可以，但我一定會講太快。

RenjiReminder.0.speaker: Renji
RenjiReminder.0.en: Cross the bridge and follow the lanterns uphill. Patrol units are still blocking the manual relay. Do not let them surround you.
RenjiReminder.0.zh_TW: 過了橋，沿著燈籠往山上走。手動繼電器前面還有巡邏機擋著。別讓它們包圍你。

RenjiRoadClear.0.speaker: Renji
RenjiRoadClear.0.en: The road is clear? Then the relay is yours. Follow the lanterns up to the viaduct and wake it up.
RenjiRoadClear.0.zh_TW: 路清開了？那繼電器就交給你了。沿著燈籠走到高架橋，把它喚醒。

Homecoming.0.speaker: Renji
Homecoming.0.en: I can see the relay's lamp from the workshop roof. Green, for the first time since the line closed.
Homecoming.0.zh_TW: 我在工坊的屋頂上就看得到繼電器的燈。是綠色的，自從這條線停駛以來，這是第一次。

Homecoming.1.speaker: Renji
Homecoming.1.en: Every signal down the line has power again. Terminal, are they all green?
Homecoming.1.zh_TW: 沿線的每一座號誌都重新通電了。終端機，全部都是綠燈嗎？

Homecoming.2.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.2.en: All green. ...One near the village just went dark. ...It is green again now.
Homecoming.2.zh_TW: 全部是綠燈。……村子附近有一座剛剛熄了。……現在又變回綠燈了。

Homecoming.3.speaker: Renji
Homecoming.3.en: Good. When that train comes, platform two shows it red, and for once it will have to stop. You woke the line up, Mio.
Homecoming.3.zh_TW: 很好。等那班列車來，第二月台就亮紅燈，這一次它非停不可。你把這條線喚醒了，澪。

Homecoming.4.en: Night falls over Hoshikawa. Mio walks home alone, and one by one the lanterns are lit.
Homecoming.4.zh_TW: 夜幕降臨星川。澪獨自走在回家的路上，燈籠一盞一盞亮了起來。

Homecoming.5.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.5.en: Mio, what are the little lights for? There are twenty-three of them. Twenty-four now.
Homecoming.5.zh_TW: 澪，那些小小的光是做什麼用的？一共有二十三個。現在是二十四個了。

Homecoming.6.speaker: Mio
Homecoming.6.en: Lanterns. Chiyo says every lantern means someone is waiting for you.
Homecoming.6.zh_TW: 燈籠啊。千代奶奶說，每一盞燈籠，都代表有人在等你回家。

Homecoming.8.speaker: Mio
Homecoming.8.en: Everyone here, I suppose. My mother used to light one on our porch every night, even after the cities went dark to us—
Homecoming.8.zh_TW: 這裡的大家吧。我媽媽以前每天晚上，都會在我們家的廊下點一盞，就算城市跟我們斷了線以後也一樣——

Homecoming.9.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.9.en: Mio! The freight terminal's lights just changed. Something is moving on the loading platform. I have to go and look at the locks.
Homecoming.9.zh_TW: 澪！貨運總站的燈剛剛變了。裝貨月台上有東西在動。我得去看看那些鎖。

Homecoming.11.speaker: Zero
Homecoming.11.en: Goodnight, Mio. Thank you for the rice paddies.
Homecoming.11.zh_TW: 晚安，澪。謝謝你給我稻田。

Homecoming.12.en: The link goes quiet. Far beyond the viaduct, the city keeps shining.
Homecoming.12.zh_TW: 連結安靜了下來。高架橋的遠方，城市依然閃耀著。

DayTwo.1.speaker: Zero
DayTwo.1.en: Mio? Morning. Sixty-eight beats a minute. I'm only counting a little.
DayTwo.1.zh_TW: 澪？早上了喔。一分鐘六十八下。我只數了一點點。

DayTwo.3.speaker: Mio
DayTwo.3.en: Last night, on the loading platform. What was moving there?
DayTwo.3.zh_TW: 昨晚在裝貨月台上動的，是什麼？

DayTwo.4.speaker: Zero
DayTwo.4.zh_TW: 沒什麼。……那不在我的工作裡。

DayTwo.6.speaker: Zero
DayTwo.6.en: Footsteps! I can hear footsteps outside. Three people. Is the village awake already?
DayTwo.6.zh_TW: 腳步聲！我聽到外面有腳步聲。三個人。村子已經醒了嗎？

DayTwo.7.speaker: Mio
DayTwo.7.en: Hoshikawa's always up before me. Two days until that train. Let's go and see Renji.
DayTwo.7.zh_TW: 星川一向比我早起。離那班列車只剩兩天了。我們去找蓮司吧。

HalfDone.0.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.0.en: Morning, Mio. Terminal, report the signals at Hoshikawa Station.
HalfDone.0.zh_TW: 早啊，澪。終端機，回報星川站的號誌。

HalfDone.1.speaker: Zero
HalfDone.1.en: Every signal on the line has power. Hoshikawa Station's home signal has power, and answers only to the lever in the station's signal box.
HalfDone.1.zh_TW: 沿線號誌全部通電。星川站的進站號誌已通電，但只受站內號誌所的拉桿控制。

HalfDone.2.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.2.en: ...Last night I said platform two would show that train red. I was wrong.
HalfDone.2.zh_TW: ……我昨晚說，第二月台會亮紅燈給那班列車看。我錯了。

HalfDone.3.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.3.en: Nothing out here can turn that signal. Someone has to get inside the station and pull the lever. And the train comes the day after tomorrow.
HalfDone.3.zh_TW: 從這裡扳不動那座號誌。得有人進站，去拉那根拉桿。列車後天就到。

HalfDone.5.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.5.en: The station road is under a rockfall, and past it the station belongs to SIRIUS. And I can't go with you.
HalfDone.5.zh_TW: 往車站的路被落石擋住了，再過去的車站是天狼的地盤。而且，我不能跟你去。

HalfDone.6.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.6.en: If the relay goes down, every signal goes dark, and I'm the only one who can fix it. That plaza is also the robots' way down to the village.
HalfDone.6.zh_TW: 繼電器一斷，號誌就全熄了，壞了只有我修得好。那座廣場也是機器人下山進村的路。

HalfDone.7.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.7.en: The village has taken turns up there since last night. From this evening I'll hold it myself. But you're not going alone. Find two people to go with you.
HalfDone.7.zh_TW: 從昨晚起，村裡的人就輪流上去看著。今晚起換我自己守。可是我不會讓你一個人去。找兩個人跟你一起。

HalfDone.8.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.8.en: And my telephone: is it working yet? I'll hook it onto the line by the relay. There are still old phone boxes along the line. Find one on the way and call me.
HalfDone.8.zh_TW: 還有，我的電話修好了沒？我要把它接上繼電器旁的線路。沿線還留著舊的電話箱，你在路上找到一個，就打回來。

HalfDone.10.speaker: Renji
HalfDone.10.en: Then finish it, and get ready. Bring it to me when you are.
HalfDone.10.zh_TW: 那就修完，去準備。好了就拿來給我。

RenjiReady.0.speaker: Renji
RenjiReady.0.en: Two people to go with you, KOMA to shift that rockfall, and my telephone working. Then come and see me.
RenjiReady.0.zh_TW: 找好跟你去的兩個人，請 KOMA 來搬落石，再把電話修好。都好了就來找我。

SotaJoins.0.speaker: Mio
SotaJoins.0.en: Sota. The train comes the day after tomorrow, and someone has to get inside Hoshikawa Station to stop it.
SotaJoins.0.zh_TW: 颯太。列車後天會來。要讓它停下，得有人進星川站。

SotaJoins.2.speaker: Sota
SotaJoins.2.en: Not along the tracks. They're the city's road now, with rail crawlers on them day and night. And the old road's tunnel came down in the spring rains.
SotaJoins.2.zh_TW: 不能沿著鐵軌走。那裡現在是城市的路，白天晚上都有巡軌機。舊路的隧道也在春天的大雨裡塌了。

SotaJoins.3.speaker: Sota
SotaJoins.3.en: I've run letters all over these hills. There's a way round the mountain. A whole day's walk, and a night out on the way.
SotaJoins.3.zh_TW: 我送信把這一帶的山都跑遍了。有條繞過山的路。要走一整天，中間還得在路上過一夜。

SotaJoins.4.speaker: Sota
SotaJoins.4.en: My brother was taken at that station. Five years ago. I'm going.
SotaJoins.4.zh_TW: 我哥就是在那個車站被帶走的。五年前。所以我要去。

SotaJoins.5.speaker: Sota
SotaJoins.5.en: The signal box is upstairs, above the main hall.
SotaJoins.5.zh_TW: 號誌所在二樓，大廳上面。

SotaJoins.7.speaker: Sota
SotaJoins.7.en: ...My brother told me. A long time ago.

Crossbow.0.speaker: Chiaki
Crossbow.0.en: Mio, good. Terminal, what medicine is on that train? Every box, if you can.
Crossbow.0.zh_TW: 澪，你來得正好。終端機，那班列車上載了哪些藥？能全部說出來嗎？

Crossbow.1.speaker: Zero
Crossbow.1.en: Cough syrup, sixty boxes. Fever medicine, forty. Antibiotics, forty. Bandages and salve, sixty. Two hundred boxes in all.
Crossbow.1.zh_TW: 咳嗽糖漿六十箱。退燒藥四十箱。抗生素四十箱。繃帶和藥膏六十箱。共計兩百箱。

Crossbow.2.speaker: Chiaki
Crossbow.2.en: I can't leave the clinic. So, Yui, you learn them. Cough syrup first, for Grandpa Tetsu. Then the fever medicine, then the antibiotics.
Crossbow.2.zh_TW: 我得留在診所。所以結衣，你來記。第一是咳嗽藥，給鐵爺爺的。再來是退燒藥，然後是抗生素。

Crossbow.3.speaker: Yui
Crossbow.3.en: Cough syrup, fever medicine, anti... antibiotics! Cough, fever, the long one. Got it!
Crossbow.3.zh_TW: 咳嗽藥、退燒藥、抗……抗生素！咳嗽、發燒、很長的那個。記住了啦！

Crossbow.4.speaker: Yui
Crossbow.4.en: Oh! And Mio, I fell on the night road. My crossbow's trigger spring snapped, and I can't do springs.
Crossbow.4.zh_TW: 啊，還有澪。我在夜路上摔了一跤，十字弓扳機裡的彈簧斷掉了。彈簧我自己修不來啦。

Crossbow.5.speaker: Mio
Crossbow.5.en: Give it here. I've got a spare in my kit.
Crossbow.5.zh_TW: 給我。我的工具包裡有備用的。

Crossbow.6.en: Mio opens the crossbow's lock, fits the spare spring and works the trigger until it clicks clean.
Crossbow.6.zh_TW: 澪打開十字弓的機匣，換上備用彈簧，一次次扣動扳機，直到它清脆地響了一聲。

Crossbow.7.speaker: Yui
Crossbow.7.zh_TW: 喀噠一聲耶！澪，你好厲害！

Crossbow.8.speaker: Chiaki
Crossbow.8.en: Here, two remedies for the road. And bring everyone back to me in one piece.
Crossbow.8.zh_TW: 來，兩份藥草給你們路上用。還有，大家都要平安回到我這裡。

KomaAsks.0.speaker: Mio
KomaAsks.0.en: KOMA, the station road is under a rockfall. Can you move the boulders?
KomaAsks.0.zh_TW: KOMA，往車站的路被落石擋住了。你搬得動那些石頭嗎？

KomaAsks.1.speaker: KOMA-7
KomaAsks.1.en: This request requires the keeper's consent.

KomaAsks.2.en: Mio fetches Haruka from the fields, and the three of them go round to the Mori house's engawa.
KomaAsks.2.zh_TW: 澪從田裡叫來春花，三個人繞到森家的緣廊。

KomaAsks.3.speaker: Haruka
KomaAsks.3.en: Grandpa? KOMA needs your word. Mio's going to the station.
KomaAsks.3.zh_TW: 爺爺？KOMA 需要你一句話。澪要去車站。

KomaAsks.4.en: From inside the house comes a long cough, then Grandpa Tetsu's voice.
KomaAsks.4.zh_TW: 屋裡傳來一陣長長的咳嗽，接著是鐵爺爺的聲音。

KomaAsks.6.speaker: Tetsuzo
KomaAsks.6.en: Mio, I'm counting on you for the cough medicine. KOMA, you come back safe too.
KomaAsks.6.zh_TW: 澪，咳嗽藥就拜託你了。KOMA，你也要平安回來。

KomaAsks.7.speaker: KOMA-7
KomaAsks.7.en: Keeper's voice confirmed. This unit walks slowly. It will set out tonight.
KomaAsks.7.zh_TW: 確認主人聲音。本機走得很慢，今晚就出發。

KomaAsks.8.speaker: Haruka
KomaAsks.8.en: Forty years, and KOMA's never taken an order from anyone but Grandpa. He'll go up with Renji at dusk.
KomaAsks.8.zh_TW: 四十年了，KOMA 從來沒聽過爺爺以外的人的命令。他傍晚會跟蓮司一起上去。

PhoneFixed.0.en: Mio twists the last wire home, closes the telephone's case and gives its crank a turn. The bell answers with one small ring.
PhoneFixed.0.zh_TW: 澪把最後一條線接好，闔上電話的外殼，搖了一下把手。電鈴輕輕回應了一聲。

PhoneFixed.1.speaker: Zero
PhoneFixed.1.en: A telephone is a terminal for two people. I like it.
PhoneFixed.1.zh_TW: 電話是給兩個人用的終端機。我喜歡。

PhoneFixed.2.speaker: Mio
PhoneFixed.2.en: Renji will like it even more.

ChiyoLamp.0.speaker: Chiyo
ChiyoLamp.0.en: So you are going to the station. When you all come home, I will light a lantern at the east gate for you.
ChiyoLamp.0.zh_TW: 要去車站了啊。等你們回來的時候，我會在東口點一盞燈。

ChiyoLamp.1.speaker: Mio
ChiyoLamp.1.en: Thank you, Chiyo. We'll follow that light home.
ChiyoLamp.1.zh_TW: 謝謝你，千代奶奶。我們一定會循著那盞燈回來。

Evening.0.speaker: Mio
Evening.0.en: Renji, your telephone. It works. And Sota and Yui are coming with me.
Evening.0.zh_TW: 蓮司，你的電話修好了。還有，颯太和結衣會跟我一起去。

Evening.1.speaker: Renji
Evening.1.en: ...Good. I'd have picked the same two.
Evening.1.zh_TW: ……是嗎。要是我來挑，也會是那兩個人。

Evening.2.speaker: Renji
Evening.2.en: Then at first light tomorrow, meet at the rockfall east of the relay plaza. I'm going up tonight with KOMA, and I'll take over the watch there.
Evening.2.zh_TW: 那就明天天一亮，在繼電器廣場東邊的落石前會合。我今晚帶 KOMA 上去，接手看守廣場。

Evening.3.speaker: Renji
Evening.3.en: And you may not have to carry the medicine home. There should still be freight handcarts on the station's platforms. If the line's quiet once that train is stopped, load them up and push them home along the rails.
Evening.3.zh_TW: 還有，藥說不定不用背回來。車站月台上應該還有貨運手推車。列車停下來之後，要是鐵軌上沒有動靜，就裝上去，沿著鐵軌推回家。

Evening.4.speaker: Mio
Evening.4.en: Home along the line. The first thing it's carried for us in twelve years.
Evening.4.zh_TW: 沿著那條線回家。這是十二年來，那條線第一次幫我們運東西。

Evening.5.speaker: Renji
Evening.5.en: Get some sleep, Mio. Tomorrow's a long walk.
Evening.5.zh_TW: 去睡一下吧，澪。明天要走很遠。

Evening.6.en: The sun goes down behind the mountains, and one by one Hoshikawa's lanterns are lit again.
Evening.6.zh_TW: 太陽落到山的另一邊，星川的燈籠又一盞一盞亮了起來。

RenjiNight.0.speaker: Renji
RenjiNight.0.en: Go home and sleep, Mio. KOMA and I have the plaza tonight. First light, here at the rockfall.
RenjiNight.0.zh_TW: 回家睡覺吧，澪。今晚廣場有 KOMA 和我看著。天一亮，就在這片落石前。

NightTwo.0.speaker: Zero
NightTwo.0.en: Mio. Sota's brother disappeared at that station, didn't he?
NightTwo.0.zh_TW: 澪。颯太的哥哥，是在那個車站不見的，對不對？

NightTwo.2.speaker: Mio
NightTwo.2.en: If he is, he won't say so.

NightTwo.3.speaker: Zero
NightTwo.3.en: ...My night shift is starting. I have to go.
NightTwo.3.zh_TW: ……我的夜班要開始了。我得走了。

NightTwo.4.speaker: Zero
NightTwo.4.en: Goodnight, Mio. Sleep well. I won't count anything tonight.
NightTwo.4.zh_TW: 晚安，澪。好好睡。今晚我什麼都不數。

DayThree.1.en: Mio rises before dawn. The terminal on her wrist is still quiet.
DayThree.1.zh_TW: 澪在天亮前起身。手腕上的終端機，還是一片安靜。

Rockfall.0.speaker: Yui
Rockfall.0.en: Mio! Over here! We beat you here, for once!
Rockfall.0.zh_TW: 澪！這邊這邊！這次是我們比較早喔！

Rockfall.1.speaker: Sota
Rockfall.1.en: Morning. The rail crawlers went past an hour ago. If we leave now, we'll be round the mountain by dark.
Rockfall.1.zh_TW: 早。巡軌機一個小時前過去了。現在出發，天黑前就能繞過山。

Rockfall.3.en: Renji hauls the barrier aside, and KOMA-7 lifts the boulders one by one and sets them down off the road.
Rockfall.3.zh_TW: 蓮司把路障拖到一旁，KOMA-7 把落石一塊塊抬起來，放到路邊。

Rockfall.4.speaker: KOMA-7
Rockfall.4.en: This unit is very good at moving rocks. Also tomatoes.
Rockfall.4.zh_TW: 本機很擅長搬石頭，也擅長番茄。

Rockfall.5.en: Renji clips his telephone onto the old line's junction box and cranks it. Somewhere down the cleared road, faint but clear, a phone box's bell rings with it.
Rockfall.5.zh_TW: 蓮司把電話接上舊線的端子箱，搖了搖把手。清開的路前方某處，一個電話箱的鈴聲跟著響起，微弱卻清楚。

Rockfall.6.speaker: Renji
Rockfall.6.en: The old line still carries a voice. Find a phone box when you can, and call me.
Rockfall.6.zh_TW: 舊線還能傳聲音。找到電話箱就打給我。

Rockfall.7.speaker: Renji
Rockfall.7.en: All three of you come back.

Rockfall.8.speaker: Yui
Rockfall.8.en: All three of us, and the medicine too! That's a promise, not a question!
Rockfall.8.zh_TW: 三個人，還有藥也要喔！這不是在問你，是約定喔！

Rockfall.9.speaker: KOMA-7
Rockfall.9.en: This unit will return to the tomatoes. Bring back the cough medicine.
Rockfall.9.zh_TW: 本機將返回番茄身邊。請把咳嗽藥帶回來。

Rockfall.10.speaker: Sota
Rockfall.10.en: Let's go. I'll show you the way round the mountain.

RenjiSeesOff.0.speaker: Renji
RenjiSeesOff.0.en: Find a phone box when you can, and call me. All three of you come back.
RenjiSeesOff.0.zh_TW: 找到電話箱就打給我。三個人都要回來。

RelayAsleep.0.speaker: Zero
RelayAsleep.0.en: This is the manual relay! It's asleep. Renji has a plan for it. Go and find Renji first, okay?
RelayAsleep.0.zh_TW: 這是手動繼電器！它睡著了。蓮司對它有安排。先去找蓮司，好不好？

RelayGuardedNone.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedNone.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count none still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedNone.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面一台也不剩。先把它們趕走，好不好？

RelayGuardedOne.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedOne.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count one still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedOne.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面還剩一台。先把它趕走，好不好？

RelayGuardedTwo.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedTwo.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count two still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedTwo.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面還剩兩台。先把它們趕走，好不好？

RelayGuardedThree.0.speaker: Zero
RelayGuardedThree.0.en: The patrols keep polling this relay. I count three still out there. Chase them away first, okay?
RelayGuardedThree.0.zh_TW: 巡邏機一直在呼叫這個繼電器。我數了數，外面還剩三台。先把它們趕走，好不好？

RelaySteady.0.speaker: Zero
RelaySteady.0.en: The relay is steady. Head back to Renji. ...Mio, one day I want to see this valley with my own eyes.
RelaySteady.0.zh_TW: 繼電器很穩定。回去找蓮司吧。……澪，我好想有一天，能用自己的眼睛看看這座山谷。

RelayOnline.0.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.0.en: Got it! The relay lamp just turned green. That's your signal, Mio. It's so clear.
RelayOnline.0.zh_TW: 接上了！繼電器的燈變綠了。那是給你的進行號誌，澪。看得好清楚。

RelayOnline.1.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.1.en: Wait. Is that wind? It came down the mountain and it smells sharp and clean. What is it?
RelayOnline.1.zh_TW: 等一下。那是風嗎？它從山上吹下來，聞起來尖尖的、清清的。那是什麼？

RelayOnline.2.speaker: Mio
RelayOnline.2.en: Cedar. The whole pass is full of them.
RelayOnline.2.zh_TW: 杉木。整個山口到處都是。

RelayOnline.3.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.3.en: Cedar. I'm keeping that one too.

RelayOnline.4.speaker: Zero
RelayOnline.4.en: Every signal on the old line just woke up, all the way to Hoshikawa Station. Now that train has to listen to us. Go tell Renji!
RelayOnline.4.zh_TW: 舊線上的號誌全都醒過來了，一路到星川站。現在那班列車得聽我們的了。快去告訴蓮司！

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.0.speaker: Chiyo
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.0.en: The cities still shine at night. But their streets belong to machines now. Here, every lantern means someone is waiting for you.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.0.zh_TW: 城市到了晚上還是亮的。可是那些街道，現在是屬於機器的了。在這裡啊，每一盞燈籠，都代表有人在等你。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.1.speaker: Chiyo
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.1.en: ...That terminal on your wrist. You never let anyone look at it. May I? Gold casing, a little jade lamp.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.1.zh_TW: ……你手腕上的那台終端機。你從來不肯讓人看。可以讓我看看嗎？金色的外殼，一盞小小的翡翠色燈。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.2.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.2.en: It's just the old one from the signal box, Chiyo. Nothing special.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.2.zh_TW: 只是號誌所裡那台舊的而已，千代奶奶。沒什麼特別的。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.3.speaker: Chiyo
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.3.en: Shio wore one just like it. Your mother never went anywhere without hers.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.3.zh_TW: 汐也戴過一台一模一樣的。你媽媽不管去哪裡，都帶著她那一台。

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.4.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.4.en: Everyone who worked the line had one, didn't they?
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.4.zh_TW: 在鐵道上工作的人，每個人都有一台，對吧？

FirstMeeting.Chiyo.6.en: Chiyo looks past you, toward the city, and says nothing more.
FirstMeeting.Chiyo.6.zh_TW: 千代越過你的肩膀望向城市的方向，沒有再說什麼。

FirstMeeting.Haruka.0.speaker: Haruka
FirstMeeting.Haruka.0.en: KOMA keeps our irrigation running without a network. Old machines are our neighbors. The amber-eyed patrols beyond the bridge are not.
FirstMeeting.Haruka.0.zh_TW: KOMA 讓我們的灌溉不用網路也能運轉。老機器是我們的鄰居。橋那邊琥珀色眼睛的巡邏機可就不是了。

FirstMeeting.Haruka.1.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.Haruka.1.en: Correction: this unit is the best neighbor.
FirstMeeting.Haruka.1.zh_TW: 更正：本機是最好的鄰居。

FirstMeeting.Haruka.2.speaker: Haruka
FirstMeeting.Haruka.2.en: He's been like this since Grandpa Tetsu registered him. Forty years of the same jokes.
FirstMeeting.Haruka.2.zh_TW: 自從鐵爺爺幫他登記以後，他就一直這樣。四十年了，老是同樣的笑話。

FirstMeeting.Haruka.3.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.Haruka.3.en: Registered keeper: Mori Tetsuzo. Keeper status: napping on the engawa. This unit answers to its keeper, not to the network.
FirstMeeting.Haruka.3.zh_TW: 登記主人：森鐵藏。主人狀態：在緣廊打盹。本機聽從主人，不聽從網路。

FirstMeeting.Haruka.4.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.Haruka.4.en: And that's why the patrols can't order you around. Lucky you.
FirstMeeting.Haruka.4.zh_TW: 所以巡邏機才管不了你。真好命。

FirstMeeting.Haruka.5.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.Haruka.5.en: Correct. Patrols have no keepers. Very lonely machines.
FirstMeeting.Haruka.5.zh_TW: 正確。巡邏機沒有主人。是非常孤單的機器。

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.0.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.0.en: Morning diagnostic: tomatoes healthy. Humans worried. Reminder for Mio: this unit is still far better company than your terminal.
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.0.zh_TW: 早晨診斷：番茄健康。人類焦慮。提醒澪：本機今天依然比你的終端機好聊多了。

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.1.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.1.en: Query for Mio's terminal: do you know what tomatoes feel like?
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.1.zh_TW: 向澪的終端機提問：你知道番茄摸起來是什麼感覺嗎？

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.2.speaker: Zero
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.2.en: No. This terminal has never touched one.
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.2.zh_TW: 不知道。本終端機從來沒有摸過。

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.3.speaker: KOMA-7
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.3.en: Round. Warm in the afternoon. Query: terminal, where is your body?
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.3.zh_TW: 圓的。下午是溫的。提問：終端機，你的本體在哪裡？

FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.4.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.4.en: It doesn't have one, KOMA. It's just a terminal. Go and look after your tomatoes.
FirstMeeting.KOMA-7.4.zh_TW: 它沒有本體啦，KOMA。只是一台終端機。快回去照顧你的番茄吧。

FirstMeeting.Chiaki.0.speaker: Chiaki
FirstMeeting.Chiaki.0.en: Hold your guard against a strike, or tap it just before impact to deflect. A broken posture leaves you exposed. Let me patch you up.
FirstMeeting.Chiaki.0.zh_TW: 承受攻擊時按住防禦，或是在命中前一瞬間輕點，就能彈反。架勢一旦崩潰，你就會露出破綻。來，我幫你處理一下。

FirstMeeting.Chiaki.1.speaker: Chiaki
FirstMeeting.Chiaki.1.en: And Mio, my shelves are nearly bare. One week of medicine for the whole village. If you find any out there, bring it home.
FirstMeeting.Chiaki.1.zh_TW: 還有，澪，我的藥櫃快空了。整個村子只剩一個星期的藥。要是在外面找到，就帶回來。

FirstMeeting.Sota.0.speaker: Sota
FirstMeeting.Sota.0.en: Watch for the red diamond on a patrol: that sweeping attack cannot be blocked. Dodge through it or jump away.
FirstMeeting.Sota.0.zh_TW: 注意巡邏機身上的紅色菱形：那種橫掃攻擊擋不住。要穿過去，或是跳開。

FirstMeeting.Sota.1.speaker: Sota
FirstMeeting.Sota.1.en: ...Say, terminal. Who's on the other end of you?

FirstMeeting.Sota.2.speaker: Zero
FirstMeeting.Sota.2.en: This terminal answers queries about the old line.
FirstMeeting.Sota.2.zh_TW: 本終端機負責回答舊線的相關查詢。

FirstMeeting.Sota.3.speaker: Mio
FirstMeeting.Sota.3.en: Told you, Sota. It's old wiring from the signal box. It only knows the line.
FirstMeeting.Sota.3.zh_TW: 我就說吧，颯太。那是號誌所的舊線路，它只知道鐵路的事。

FirstMeeting.Sota.4.speaker: Sota
FirstMeeting.Sota.4.en: Huh. Then if it ever knows when that train is due, tell me first. I'd want to be there.
FirstMeeting.Sota.4.zh_TW: 哦。那如果它哪天知道那班列車什麼時候到，第一個告訴我。我想在場。

FirstMeeting.Sota.5.en: Sota keeps his eyes on your wrist a moment longer than he needs to.
FirstMeeting.Sota.5.zh_TW: 颯太盯著你的手腕，看得比需要的還久了一點。

FirstMeeting.Yui.0.speaker: Yui
FirstMeeting.Yui.0.en: Chiaki is teaching me medicines! This one's for fevers, this one's for coughs, and this one tastes awful. I tried it.
FirstMeeting.Yui.0.zh_TW: 千秋在教我認藥！這個治發燒，這個治咳嗽，然後這個超級難吃。我試過了。

FirstMeeting.Yui.2.speaker: Yui
FirstMeeting.Yui.2.en: Like the inside of an old boot! Terminal, remember that one: old boot.
FirstMeeting.Yui.2.zh_TW: 像舊靴子裡面的味道！終端機，記下來：舊靴子。

Komorebi.Naomi.0.speaker: Naomi
Komorebi.Naomi.0.en: Welcome to Komorebi, Mio. Travelers from Hoshikawa take the cedar bridge below the orchards. There is always a place by our stove when the mountain mist rolls in.
Komorebi.Naomi.0.zh_TW: 歡迎來到木漏日，澪。從星川來的旅人，都是走果園下方的杉木橋過來的。山霧飄下來的時候，我們的火爐邊永遠有個位子。

Komorebi.Emiko.0.speaker: Emiko
Komorebi.Emiko.0.en: That pass is a long walk. Sit for a moment: I can treat your wounds and refill your remedies. The clinic keeps its doors open for both villages.
Komorebi.Emiko.0.zh_TW: 那個山口要走很遠吧。坐下來歇一會兒：我可以處理你的傷口，也能補充你的藥草。診所的大門，對兩個村子都是敞開的。

Komorebi.Toma.0.speaker: Toma
Komorebi.Toma.0.en: These trees fed our grandparents before the city grid reached the valley. Now they feed our neighbors again. Follow the south lanterns to the bridge if you are returning to Hoshikawa.
Komorebi.Toma.0.zh_TW: 在城市電網還沒送進山谷之前，這些樹就養活了我們的祖父母。現在，它們又在養活我們的鄰居。如果你要回星川，就沿著南邊的燈籠走到橋邊。
